title: Setup GitHub Actions CI pipeline for semver static binary releases
description: Configure GoReleaser or custom matrix workflow to build static binaries (Linux/Darwin amd64/arm64), inject semver via ldflags, and publish GitHub releases on tag push.

title: Phase 5: Self-Evaluating PR & Gitea Integration
description: Once spec verification passes inside sandbox worktree, generate conventional commit, push feature branch, open pull request on local Gitea or GitHub, and emit completion audit artifact.

title: Phase 4: agent-sandbox OCI Image & Host GPU Bridge
description: Package lokol into an OCI container image in agent-sandbox/images/agents/lokol, configuring unprivileged container execution and bridge to host llama-server over host.containers.internal:8080.

title: Phase 3: Slot-Aware Context Budgeting & Compaction Governor
description: Monitor real-time context token pressure via /slots. When occupancy exceeds 60% of n_ctx, automatically condense intermediate turn history while preserving SPEC.md and latest test assertion state.

title: Phase 2: Structured Spec Protocol (lokol exec --spec SPEC.md)
description: Implement parser and bounded state machine for SPEC.md with pre-flight check, target file constraints, and an automated verification gate locking task_finish until exit 0.

title: Phase 1: In-Repo MCP Context Refinery (lokol-mcp)
description: Implement standalone MCP server in cmd/lokol-mcp exposing read_outline, read_window, and test_verifier over JSON-RPC stdio to filter noisy outputs before hitting the model.

title: Epic: Unattended Spec-Driven Autonomous Execution Engine
description: Transform lokol into an unattended autonomous coding engine capable of taking a structured SPEC.md and executing until passing verification within agent-sandbox.
